title: Dictionary literal key-count inline check
description: Inline .Keys.Count checks directly against freshly constructed dictionary/hashtable literals are brittle and can hide intent. Prefer assigning to a variable and then validating count with explicit null-safe semantics.
detection_method: Regex scan for inline dictionary literal followed by .Keys.Count.
remediation: Assign the dictionary/hashtable to a variable first, then use @($dict.Keys).Count with explicit null/empty guards where needed.
